03 / Portfolio & performance

Defined risk.
Visible decisions.

Our initial allocation is in development. The figures here describe the Round 1 challenge mandate, not realized performance.

Simulated starting capital$100m
Annual volatility target8%
Permitted volatility range
7–9% annually
Investment universe
Broad asset-class ETFs & USD cash
Constraints
Long only · No leverage
Reporting currency
USD
Performance reporting Not yet available

Once the portfolio is established, updates will include cumulative return, annualized volatility, Sharpe ratio and maximum drawdown, with observation dates and data sources.

Historical backtests will be reported separately, with sample periods, rebalancing rules and assumptions.

Holdings and risk contributions will accompany the first allocation report.
